Transcripts

To change these transcripts, edit the transcripts page for Hector The Mentor.

Player: hi
Hector the Mentor: Hail, traveller and welcome! I can help you getting started, offer various services or you can assist me on my mission, what shall it be.
Player: started
Hector the Mentor: Besides all of the services I can provide, I am also on a mission I could need some help with. The cave near here could be just what an aspiring adventurer needs. There are also many fellow adventurers in Tibia, don't hesitate to ask them for help or even join forces with others to overcome the many perils of this world!
Player: services
Hector the Mentor: I offer what equipment is left from my fellow students for trade as well as banking services, teach spells and provide healing.
Player: trade
Hector the Mentor: Certainly, surely you can make some use of this for a small obolus.
Player: name
Hector the Mentor: My name is Hector, pleased to meet you, traveller!
Player: job
Hector the Mentor: I am a philosopher from Thais, working both for king Tibianus as an advisor as well as mentoring new students of the Edron Academy. Which is also part of the reason why I'm here now.
Player: time
Hector the Mentor: It should be exactly HH:MM am by now.
Player: Thais
Hector the Mentor: Thais is the commercial and cultural centre of Tibia. There's a lot to see and do.
Player: Edron
Hector the Mentor: I've been teaching and lecturing at Edron's academy for decades. It's an honourable faculty with many bright and talented individuals such as my dear friend and colleague Spectulus.
Player: Spectulus
Hector the Mentor: A dear friend of mine who I have worked with many an hour on countless projects and experiments. He's quite the character, always busy but will grow on you over time.
Player: Tibianus
Hector the Mentor: King Tibianus is the righteous and wise ruler I have the honour of working as an advisor for.
Player: Eclesius
Hector the Mentor: A troubled mind but he is kind at heart. He would lose his head if it wasn't firmly attached, however.
Player: excalibug
Hector the Mentor: A tall tale, some warriors are quite obsessed with it.
Player: temple
Hector the Mentor: I took my vows to help any adventurer in need, including healing and other services.
Player: bye
Hector the Mentor: Farewell, traveller and take care!

Hector The Mentor
